Priya_CS: Morning all — quick health check for Orion Health's dedicated pool. Saturation hit ~92% in the last 24h, GPU hours up +38% WoW, queue depth spiked to ~160 (baseline ~20). We're seeing 95p latency breach on generative routes and spend +24%. Marking this as onboarding -> renewal-risk watch. Posting metric snapshot below.

util-bot: METRIC SNAPSHOT:
- window: 2026-03-18T00:00Z to 2026-03-19T00:00Z
- GPU hours: 1,420 (prev 1,030)
- avg queue depth: 42
- peak queue depth: 160 at 09:12 UTC
- 95p latency (gen routes): 1.2s (SLO 1.0s)
- error rate: 0.8% (routing timeouts)
- estimated spend overrun: +$2.2k/day
logs (sample):
```json
{"tenant":"orion-health","route":"/v1/generate","error":"timeout","ts":"2026-03-19T09:12:01Z"}
```

Diego_SRE: Looks like a nightly re-eval + a couple long-running eval jobs that bypass KV cache. Can you share request-length distribution? Suggest immediate per-tenant throttle on heavy gen routes and flip to aggressive KV caching for this tenant as a temporary mitigation.

Alex_Orion: Yep — we kicked off eval pipeline eval-20260318 overnight to test new prompts; that generated high synthetic load. We can pause the rerun and add caps on request length. Sorry for the surprise.

Priya_CS: Action items proposal: 1) SRE deploy temporary per-tenant throttle (10m canary) 2) Enable aggressive KV caching for orion-health 3) CS to schedule onboarding sync with Orion re: long-running jobs before renewal. Diego — ETA on throttle?

Diego_SRE: Pushing canary throttle in ~5m, full rollout in 30m if stable. Throttle rule I'm applying: `tenant:orion-health, route:gen/*, qps:20, burst:40` (reacted :white_check_mark:)

Lina_AE: Moving renewal risk to Amber for now. Scheduling a QBR touchpoint next Tue. Priya — can you add expected spend delta and a short summary for the exec deck? :spiral_calendar:

Priya_CS: Will update the account health doc and DM Lina + the customer. Preliminary spend delta if pattern persists: +$3k/month. I'll attach replay links and the eval pipeline id.

Diego_SRE: Canary throttle applied. Monitoring queue depth, 95p latency and error rate now. Will post an update in 10m.

util-bot: ALERT UPDATE — queue depth dropped to 18 after throttle, 95p latency back to 0.9s. Closing alert but keeping a 2h watch window.

Alex_Orion: Thanks for the quick response — we'll pause eval-20260318 and follow up with the team during the sync. Appreciate it.

Priya_CS: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups assigned: Diego_SRE (throttle verification & metrics), Priya_CS (onboarding sync + account doc), Lina_AE (renewal outreach/QBR). Reconvene if regressions. End of thread.
